title: Methods for determination of carbaryl residues in fruits and vegetables
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes spectrophotometric and gas chromatographic methods for the determination of carbaryl ( l-naphthyl-TV methyl carbamate ) residues in fruits and vegetables. •RiUes for rounding off numerical values ( revised). 3 IS : 10169 - 1982 1.1.1 Spectrophotometric method may be adopted as a limit test for routine purposes and is generally applicable at the 0"1 ppm level, whereas Gas Chromatography shall be the reference method with the limit of detection at 0*02 ppm. 1.1.2 Though no set procedure for Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC) is being prescribed, Standardized TLG procedures may be followed, if necessary for the purpose of clean up, identification and confirmation of carbaryl residues.
clause_3_terminology: Methods for determination of carbaryl residues in fruits and vegetables

chemical_properties: chloride. If the residue is expected to be greater than 2 ppm

The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
